item.title: Start New Journey
item.description: Nowadays, when you’re in Vietnam, whether you’re sitting at a sidewalk cafe or coffee shop, you always hear people talking about Bitcoin, Blockchain and trading. Even though I work in technology, I don’t fully understand what everyone is talking about. I’m not sure if what they’re saying is accurate or not. That has made me really want to learn more and explore this topic. That’s the reason I’m starting this journey.
